world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium Mexican fiesta slot game environment, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: warmly glowing colonial courtyard cantina at blue hour, richly painted hand-crafted game art. Terracotta plaster walls, turquoise wooden shutters, worn carved wood, brass lanterns, strands of small warm festival lights and colorful papel picado high overhead. At far RIGHT, an ORIGINAL jovial adult mariachi bandleader with a magnificent curled black mustache and broad red embroidered sombrero, emerald-and-gold charro jacket over white shirt, warm joyful expression. He holds two small decorated wooden maracas near his waist. His design is original, not a copied commercial mascot.
Composition: left and middle 70 percent quiet shadowed terracotta courtyard and dark teal wooden cantina details to sit behind a dominant five-reel game board. Details restrained behind board. On rightmost 25 percent the bandleader appears from waist up, dignified charismatic stylized proportions, full head and sombrero entirely within canvas with generous top space. Warm lantern light picks out embroidered gold thread and mustache. A few lush flowering bougainvillea branches at the far upper-left edge frame the scene, orange sunset beyond a distant low roof. No central arch, no baked-in board frame. Real environment depth and tactile architecture.
Style: gorgeous hand-painted 2.5D volumetric game concept art, mature whimsical realism, believable facial anatomy, expressive charismatic face, warm amber and terracotta, deep turquoise and emerald with oxblood red/gold accents. Rich texture, cinematic rim lighting, vibrant celebration without neon or cheap cartoon plastic. No thick outlines.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, slot machine, UI, grid or reels. No firearms. No copied provider artwork. Entire wide landscape is original scene art.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Attached original fiesta courtyard image is only a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE. Create a NEW transparent symbol atlas matching its hand-painted 2.5D volumetric materials, warm gold/terracotta/turquoise palette and the original mustached red-sombrero bandleader. No environment in this atlas.
Asset type: twelve isolated premium game icons on TRUE transparent alpha, landscape 4:3 canvas, ideally 2048x1536. EXACTLY four columns by three rows. The icons are separated by BIG empty transparent gaps. Each icon about 60% of its cell's maximum dimension, not touching. Mathematical cell centers x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y16.67%,50%,83.33%. Strong crisp silhouettes readable at 40px, tactile ornate gold, velvet, carved wood and glazed ceramic, mature whimsical realism, no thick cartoon outlines.
Exact reading order:
Row1 col1: shoulder-up portrait of the same ORIGINAL joyful bandleader as reference, broad red embroidered sombrero, black curled mustache, emerald/gold charro jacket, full hat contained, warm smile, compact silhouette.
Row1 col2: adult Mexican fiesta dancer portrait, warm brown skin, black hair in elegant bun, one pink flower above ear, magenta ruffled dress and small golden earrings, dignified bright smile, shoulders visible, original design.
Row1 col3: charming tan chihuahua seated on a small fuchsia velvet cushion with gold tassels, miniature straw sombrero, alert ears, beautifully painted fur.
Row1 col4: ornate purple and warm honey-wood Mexican vihuela guitar, diagonal compact pose, carved gold trim, strings and star-shaped decorative soundhole.
Row2 col1: squat red-orange hot sauce bottle with cork, blank cream label bearing only a painted chili shape, no words.
Row2 col2: large freestanding uppercase letter A, deep ruby-red enamel face and ornate thick beveled antique gold edge, chunky serif shape, no backing plaque.
Row2 col3: large freestanding uppercase letter K, warm amber-yellow enamel face and ornate thick beveled antique gold edge, chunky serif shape.
Row2 col4: large freestanding uppercase letter Q, berry-pink enamel face and ornate thick beveled antique gold edge, chunky serif shape.
Row3 col1: large freestanding uppercase letter J, emerald-green enamel face and ornate thick beveled antique gold edge, chunky serif shape.
Row3 col2: number 10 as a single compact combined symbol, turquoise-blue enamel faces and thick beveled antique gold edges, chunky serif style.
Row3 col3: one magnificent curved red chili pepper with green stem, small close-fitted gold flame motif behind, dramatic sculptural red/gold wild symbol, NO word.
Row3 col4: colorful handcrafted donkey piñata, dimensional fringed tissue paper in turquoise/magenta/gold, compact side view, no strings extending beyond its cell.
Constraints: exactly twelve fully intact icons, no overlap, no background, floor, checkerboard, cell box, gridline, watermark or logos. Only the five specified royal letter/number symbols have text. No text on characters, bottle, chili or piñata. No giant glow halos or outside shadows. Everything outside objects genuinely transparent.
atlas.spacingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY scale and placement of the attached original twelve-symbol fiesta sprite atlas. Preserve exact designs, materials, colors, the exact A/K/Q/J/10 lettering, original character identities, reading order, 4:3 canvas and true alpha transparency.
CRITICAL: shrink EVERY icon to 60% OF ITS CURRENT width and height. Do not fill empty areas. The desired image shows twelve small separated icons and conspicuously LARGE transparent empty gaps. Complete sombrero, hair, guitar, pinata ears and hooves must be entirely within their own cells. All objects opaque with natural antialiased edges; outside fully transparent, no speckles.
Put icons at exact centers of FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows: x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y=16.6667%,50%,83.3333%. Each complete icon must be centered and have generous transparent margin on all four sides. No part may cross a cell boundary.
Order stays: row1 bandleader portrait, dancer portrait, chihuahua on cushion, purple guitar; row2 sauce bottle, A, K, Q; row3 J, 10, flaming red chili, donkey pinata. No new text, labels, background, checkerboard, grids, boxes, decoration or objects. This is a spacing repair, all visual designs remain unchanged.
